title: The First New Sunscreen Filter in the U.S. in 20 Years
hook: The FDA approved bemotrizinol — a broad-spectrum UV filter used for decades in Europe and Asia — the first new sunscreen ingredient cleared in the U.S. in about 20 years.
key_points: The FDA approved bemotrizinol, a chemical sunscreen filter, for use in the U.S.
It's the first new sunscreen ingredient cleared in the country in roughly 20 years.
Bemotrizinol has been used for decades in Europe and Asia, where sunscreen options run wider.
It protects against both UVA and UVB rays — the 'broad-spectrum' coverage skin needs.
content_html: The U.S. has long had a shorter list of approved sunscreen ingredients than Europe or Asia, and that list rarely changes. So it's news that the FDA has approved bemotrizinol — a chemical UV filter already used for decades abroad — marking the first new sunscreen ingredient cleared in the country in roughly 20 years.
extra_html: As NPR's Maria Godoy reports, bemotrizinol protects against both UVA and UVB rays. That "broad-spectrum" coverage matters: UVB causes the sunburn most people associate with sun damage, while UVA penetrates deeper and contributes to aging and skin cancer risk, so a good sunscreen needs to block both. The approval doesn't change the basics of sun safety — seek shade, cover up, and reapply — but it widens the toolkit U.S. manufacturers can draw on, and over time may bring formulas already common overseas to American shelves. This is general health news; for guidance on your own skin and risk, talk to a clinician or dermatologist.

related.hook: Screening looks for cancer before symptoms start — and for a few common cancers, that early catch dramatically improves the odds.

related.title: Why Regular Checkups Matter
related.hook: The whole point of a checkup is to catch trouble while it's still quiet — before symptoms show up and while it's easiest to treat.

related.hook: Scientists say they've found the missing genetic ingredient that lets melanoma cells become effectively immortal — a discovery that could open new lines of attack on the cancer.

flashcards.prompt: Why is the FDA's approval of bemotrizinol notable?
flashcards.back_html: It's the first new sunscreen ingredient approved in the U.S. in about 20 years. The filter has long been used in Europe and Asia, where the range of approved sunscreen ingredients is wider than in the U.S.

flashcards.prompt: What kind of UV protection does bemotrizinol provide?

choices.text: Broad-spectrum — both UVA and UVB rays

flashcards.explanation_html: NPR reports the ingredient protects against both UVA and UVB. Coverage against both bands is what 'broad-spectrum' means — and what skin needs from a sunscreen.
